name: image.steady3D
title: Slices of a three-dimensional steady state

origin.description: Draws a 2-D image for each selected plane. The default loops over the third dimension.

arguments.name: dimselect
arguments.text: A dict with x, y, or z holding 1-based plane numbers.

origin.details: The state array is filled column-major with dimensions dimens. Each z plane is one image.
origin.value: A figure per plane. The coordinates are that plane's matrix.
origin.example:
out <- steady.3D(y = rep(0, 8), func = function(t, y, p) list(1 - y), dimens = c(2, 2, 2))
image(out)

translation.description: Draws a 2-D image for each selected plane. The default loops over the third dimension.

arguments.name: dimselect
arguments.text: A dict with x, y, or z holding 1-based plane numbers.

translation.details: The state array is filled column-major with dimensions dimens. Each z plane is one image.
translation.value: A figure per plane. The coordinates are that plane's matrix.
translation.example:
from rootSolve import image_steady3d, steady_3d

def approach(t, y, p):
    return [[1.0 - value for value in y]]

out = steady_3d([0.0] * 8, func=approach, dimens=(2, 2, 2))
image_steady3d(out)
